name: inference-benchmarker-xet
description: A benchmark dataset/tool for measuring model inference performance across frameworks and hardware configurations. It provides workloads and references for evaluating latency, throughput and memory usage of models under different inference settings. Primarily intended for system-level comparisons rather than model capability evaluation.
evaluation_method: Latency (ms), throughput (tokens/sec), and memory usage measurements
reputation: A small community tool available on Hugging Face for inference comparisons; modest adoption for reproducible system-level benchmarks.
